title: Tenant usage event (INV-021, INV-026)
description: Tenant-attributed usage record emitted by every billable or resource-consuming action. Source for billing, capacity planning, and customer-facing usage disclosure. v1.1.0 (v3.2): quantity changed from number to integer with explicit unit per INV-026 (numeric precision discipline).

usage_type.description: Note: time-based units are now microseconds (us) instead of milliseconds for finer-grained attribution under continuous batching

quantity.description: Integer quantity per INV-026; fractional GPU-time is recorded as integer microseconds, never as float milliseconds

unit.description: Explicit unit; must be consistent with usage_type (gpu_us → us, tokens_in → tokens, storage_bytes → bytes, edr_api_call → count)

batch_attribution_method.description: Per ADR-0033 §14.17: continuous-batched GPU attribution uses 'proportional_to_tokens_in_batch' for v1.0; deterministic per-tenant attribution validated by tests/contract/usage-attribution-deterministic.test.py

batch_id.description: For continuous-batched workloads, the batch step id; same batch_id across replicas must produce identical per-tenant rows

recorded_at_ns.description: ns since epoch; integer per INV-026
